headline: BBVA to Delist Shares from London Stock Exchange
summary: BBVA has announced plans to exclude its shares from the London Stock Exchange, citing low trading volumes.
why: Secondary exchange delistings reflect corporate efforts to reduce listing overhead and consolidate trading liquidity on primary domestic and international bourses.

impacts.name: BBVA
impacts.why: Withdrawing shares from the London Stock Exchange concentrates trading activity on other platforms.
